metadata.canonical_admission_evidence: Assignment removal, capability revocation, Workspace disablement, and Dataset visibility revocation are measured through a test-only AIEngineClient subclass that delegates to the unchanged shared canonical dispatcher. Each denied path records its expected status and no returned domain data; unexpected errors remain separate error_count values.
metadata.epic4_catalog_trial_method: Three sequential isolated PostgreSQL trials preserve the historical single-Persona series and add separate multi-Persona, multi-Organization publication at 1, 10, and 25 workers. Assignment and FunctionParameter changes occur before, never inside, measured publication calls.
metadata.memory_methodology: tracemalloc allocation and retention deltas are separate from uninstrumented latency and are not memory-leak detection.
metadata.methodology: RR-04.1 static scenarios use source-controlled transformation schemas. Persona catalog and canonical-admission scenarios are explicit isolated-database placeholders until the guarded pytest benchmark replaces them.
metadata.process_methodology: Each cold or warm trial starts a new subprocess interpreter; process-global Python state is not shared between trials.

rr04_optimization_gate.rationale: RR-04.2 remains unauthorized without a measured candidate that clears both absolute and relative Registry-owned thresholds.
